data.label: contradicted
data.reason: The source states that exactly 65 generators arrived on 12 March 2025, whereas the post claims 115 generators were received on that date.

evidence.quote: The final Eastmere delivery register states: exactly 65 generators arrived on 12 March 2025. There were no other deliveries that day.
evidence.reason: The delivery register is an official record directly stating the number of generators delivered, contradicting the claim of 115 generators.
evidence.title: Synthetic Eastmere record

claims.explanation: The claim states that Eastmere received 115 generators on 12 March 2025. The source S1 provides a delivery register record stating exactly 65 generators arrived on that date and no other deliveries occurred that day, which directly contradicts the claim.
claims.missing: Independent confirmation of the number of generators delivered to Eastmere on 12 March 2025 beyond the delivery register is missing.

sources.title: Synthetic Eastmere record
sources.text: The final Eastmere delivery register states: exactly 65 generators arrived on 12 March 2025. There were no other deliveries that day.

pipeline.scope: These labels describe the retrieved passages, not the truth of a claim or the intent of its author.
